timelines.title: Pins
timelines.description: Sharp sewing pins used to hold fabric, patterns, and seams securely in place before and during sewing.

timelines.title: Clips
timelines.description: Small hinged clips that grip fabric layers without piercing them, especially useful for thick fabrics, curves, and delicate materials.

timelines.title: Pins Cushion
timelines.description: A padded cushion designed to safely store and organize sewing pins while keeping them easy to reach.

timelines.title: Scissors
timelines.description: Sharp fabric scissors designed to cut fabric, pattern pieces, and larger sections cleanly and accurately.

timelines.title: Rotary Cutter
timelines.description: A handheld tool with a circular blade that rolls across fabric, making smooth and precise cuts, especially through multiple layers.

timelines.title: Giant Ruler & Small Ruler
timelines.description: Sewing rulers used to measure fabric, check dimensions, mark seam lines, and create accurate straight or angled lines.

timelines.title: Thread Snips
timelines.description: Small, sharp scissors designed to quickly trim thread tails, loose threads, and small fabric ends.

timelines.title: Tape Measure
timelines.description: A flexible measuring tool used to take body measurements and measure fabric, patterns, and curved areas.

timelines.title: Iron
timelines.description: A heated tool used to remove wrinkles and press seams, hems, and fabric folds for a cleaner finish.

timelines.title: Hot Ruler
timelines.description: A heat-resistant ruler that helps measure and create accurate folds, hems, and seam allowances while pressing with heat.

timelines.title: Bias Tape Maker
timelines.description: A tool that folds fabric strips evenly to create consistent bias tape for binding edges, seams, and necklines.

timelines.title: Tailor's Chalk
timelines.description: A temporary fabric-marking tool used to mark sewing lines, darts, hems, and placement points before sewing.
